name: windvane
description: Babysits a long Claude Code session so you don't have to: the context fill is watched, the recorder drafts the checkpoint, compaction happens at the right point with the state banked and the work is resumed, the rules and the checkpoint ride inside the compacted conversation and every subagent's prompt, tool results are trimmed and secrets redacted at the door, project memory and rules are a tool call away, and a token ledger, a pane and a status segment show where the session stands.

python.title: Python
python.description: The interpreter that runs the engine (3.10 or later). Empty means python on PATH; the WINDVANE_PYTHON environment variable wins over this row.

status_segment.title: Status segment
status_segment.description: Show the context fill (a share of the compaction window) and the checkpoint age in the status line.

result_budget.title: Tool result budget
result_budget.description: Characters a tool result keeps before its middle is cut (head and tail stay).

semantic.title: Semantic scoring
semantic.description: Use the sentence-transformers encoder for decision capture and memory search when the semantic extra is installed. Off, the regex tier scores.

alert_command.title: Alert command
alert_command.description: A shell command that receives one line ({message} or stdin) when an unattended run halts, hits a usage limit or needs input. Empty means no alerts.

strict_pack.title: Strict rule pack
strict_pack.description: Seed the opt-in strict pack (style and workflow rules) beside the default pack in every new project.

autonomy.title: Autonomy mode
autonomy.description: Stall nudges and the halt brake for unattended runs. Off for an attended session.

continue_after_compact.title: Continue after compaction
continue_after_compact.description: After a compaction windvane started (compact_now, or the checkpoint band), windvane sends one prompt that resumes the work from the checkpoint. Off, the session waits for the person.

early_compaction.title: Early compaction
early_compaction.description: Open the checkpoint band early: at a fill such as 40% of the compaction window, or once one turn has cost as much as $0.40. The band asks for a save and the next turn boundary after the save compacts. Empty keeps the band at its margin above the trigger.
